troubleshooting.title: Problems and what to do
troubleshooting.shortdesc: Messages you may see on the pages.

condition.p: The page says the service couldn't be reached, or the first action is slow.

cause.p: The service scales to zero between visits and is starting.

step.cmd: Wait about 15 seconds and try again.

cause.p: The sandbox has used its proposals for today.

step.cmd: Record a decision for the gap instead, or try again tomorrow.
Read the reason on each finding.

info.p: A topic whose last change was pushed directly, not merged through a reviewed pull request, fails check_approval until a reviewed change merges.

cause.p: On the generate page, Approvals read 0 appears and the approval metrics show 0.

step.cmd: Merge the review pull requests in dita-corpus.

info.p: trusts Git for approval. Until a change to each evidence topic merges through a pull request approved by a code owner, no topic counts as approved. The page reports this honestly. It isn't an error.

cause.p: The metric for authority content in downstream output says not measured.

step.cmd: Check that the service has the DITA-OT output.

info.p: The scan needs the built HTML for both packs. Without it the metric can't run. It also isn't reported as a pass unless the control search on the authority pack finds the content.

cause.p: After a download, the message says the manifest hash differs from the one shown.

step.cmd: Select Generate packs again, then download.

info.p: This can happen if the service restarted onto a new corpus commit between the two steps.
